verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs cover core subscription billing primitives: attach (new subscriptions/upgrades/downgrades), previewAttach for proration preview, createSchedule for multi-phase plans/trials transitions, multiAttach, credit systems, usage-based pricing, and webhooks for plan change events, backed by CLI tooling to define/push plans. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for billing/entitlements though also raises a security IDOR concern unrelated to billing logic correctness. missing for 10: explicit first-party trial-period configuration documentation and independent hands-on verification of proration accuracy/upgrade-downgrade billing correctness.
